youtube.title: Bhai Dooj par Yamraj behen Yamuna ke ghar kyun gaye? 🪔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Bhai Dooj ki katha: Suryaputra Yamraj kai varson tak apni behen Yamuna se milne nahi ja paye. Ek din Kartik shukla dwitiya ko wo Yamuna ke ghar pahunche, aur Yamuna ne tilak lagakar, aarti utarkar unhe pyaar se bhojan karaya.

Yamraj prasann hue aur Yamuna se vardan maangne ko kaha. Yamuna ne maanga ki is din jo bhai behen ke ghar jaakar tilak lagwaye aur bhojan kare, use Yamraj ka bhay na ho. Yamraj ne 'tathastu' kaha, aur tabhi se Yama Dwitiya yaani Bhai Dooj manaya jaata hai.

Katha ka strot: Padma Purana aur Skanda Purana ki parampara (Yama Dwitiya).
